 National media, Scarlet Nation predictions for Rutgers vs Northwestern
 The picks are in for Rutgers' upcoming game against Northwestern. 
 Bobby Deren 11 Rutgers travels to Evanston on Saturday as a 16.5-point underdog against No. 24 Northwestern. The Scarlet Knights are 2-4 overall and 1-2 in the Big Ten after a 37-30 win at Maryland last week. Northwestern is 5-1 and 2-1 in conference play, with its only loss coming against Indiana by six points. The Wildcats have won three straight and average 33.5 points and 424.5 yards per game. 
 Kickoff is set for noon at Ryan Field and will be streamed on Peacock.
 Rutgers has not beaten a ranked opponent since a 31-0 win over No. 23 South Florida in 2009. The Scarlet Knights have not won a road game against a ranked team since 2008. Northwestern has not surrendered more than 29 points in any game this season and ranks fifth in the Big Ten in rushing offense at 191.5 yards per game.
 National outlets and Scarlet Nation staffers have weighed in on the matchup.  The picks are in and here's a look at who is expected to come away with the win.
 SCARLET NATION
 Bobby Deren: Northwestern 34 Rutgers 21
"The Rutgers offense has been playing better but it will take a standout performance on both sides of the football for Rutgers to pull off the road upset. The Scarlet Knights caught the Wildcats on an up year as OC Chip Kelly has the offense clicking in his first year with the program. Look for Rutgers to play tough without any quit, but this Northwestern team has too much for Rutgers to overcome."
 Kristian Dyer:  Northwestern 45 Rutgers 24
"Have a feeling that Rutgers will throw the kitchen sink at Northwestern. This is one where Rutgers is playing with house money as a win would offset the struggles from early in the season.Northwestern does what Rutgers wants to do: Run the ball and play stout defense. Think Iowa-lite (not in a bad or derogatory way). This is a good team."

 This will be the first meeting between the two teams since Rutgers claimed a 24-7 win during the 2023 season. It will also be the third road contest of the season for the Scarlet Knights, who are 1-1, with a win over Maryland and a loss at Boston College.
